evidence.text:
If you are planning a party or event in the Greenwood, SC area, you have several excellent local options for bounce houses, water slides, and party equipment rentals. Whether you are looking for an all-inclusive indoor venue or standard backyard delivery, these top choices are ready to help you pull off a great event.
Top Local Pick
For the smoothest all-around experience, I highly recommend checking out Jumping Jax LLC. What makes them stand out is their total flexibility. They operate a dedicated indoor play facility on Beaudrot Rd—which is a fantastic backup option if you want to wear the kids out without worrying about South Carolina heat or unpredictable rain—but they also offer a robust residential delivery and setup service. 
Jumping Jax
 +1
The Selection: They offer classic jumpers like their 1-Day Castle or Tiger Belly Bounce starting around $150, themed options like the Dalmatian house or World of Disney area for $175, and larger combo bounce-and-slide setups ranging from $175 to $275. 
Jumping Jax
 +1
The Experience: Parents love their reliable communication. They typically call the day before your reservation to verify delivery logistics, and their setup crew is known for being friendly and efficient. 
Strong Alternative Providers
If you want to shop around for specific themes, packages, or availability, these local providers also serve the immediate Greenwood area:

Pro-Tips for Booking Inflatables in Greenwood
Check the Inclusions: Always ask if delivery, setup, and stakes/sandbags are included in the base price, or if there is an extra mileage fee depending on how far out you live.
Power Requirements: Most standard bounce houses require a dedicated 110V circuit within 50–100 feet of the setup area. If you are hosting your party at a local park (like Grace Street Park or Westside Park), you will likely need to rent a generator from the provider. 
Jumping Jax
 +1
Weather Policies: Before signing a contract, verify the company's rain and high-wind cancellation policy so you know how late you can pivot without losing your deposit.
To help narrow this down for your party, let me know:
What date is the event and what is the age group of the kids?
Are you setting up on grass or pavement, and will you need water slide capabilities?
Do you also need extra party supplies like tables, chairs, or concession machines?
